# lua-webcall-model

Vendored transport dependency for lua-web-scav.

This is the standalone lua-webcall-model library. It provides a small HTTP/HTTPS
request abstraction for Lua/Luvit and intentionally does not parse or interpret
remote content.

The source is kept here because lua-web-scav has no deployment pipeline for
resolving the standalone dependency at runtime.

See the upstream project for the independent library history:
https://github.com/OverrideDeveloper/lua-webcall-model
